subject: Oakridge County: privacy addendum & DPIA evidence handoff
messages:
From: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@oakridge.gov>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oakridge County Legal <procurement@oakridge.gov>, Diana Shaw <diana.shaw@consult-privacy.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Request: privacy addendum / DPIA evidence (Oakridge County procurement)

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the demo last week — Oakridge County procurement is preparing our vendor packet for the Dec 15 contract committee. We need to collect a completed privacy addendum (county standard DPA with SCCs), a filled DPIA template, and attestation/evidence for recent security posture items. Specifically:

- SOC 2 Type II report (or bridge letter if report is not current)
- Example retention & audit-log evidence (retention policy excerpt + sample logs)
- SCCs execution checklist or signed annex
- Completed county DPIA spreadsheet (we'll attach)

Can you confirm Redwood can provide ETA for those artifacts and whether you accept our DPA language? Ideally we'd get a consolidated package by 2026-12-08 to get legal review in time.

Laura Jensen
Senior Procurement Analyst
Oakridge County
attachments: Oakridge_DPIA_template.xlsx (requested)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@oakridge.gov>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T16:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: privacy addendum / DPIA evidence (Oakridge County procurement)

Hi Laura — thanks for the note and for sending the DPIA spreadsheet. We'll take this on and aim to get a consolidated package by 2026-12-08.

Planned next steps:
- I'll coordinate with Security to fill the DPIA and pull supporting artifacts.
- Marissa will prepare the SCCs execution checklist and a short bridging attestation for our latest SOC 2 Type II period.
- Monica will confirm contract exceptions and whether we can sign the county DPA or propose narrow redlines.

Can you confirm whether DocuSign is preferred for execution? Also please confirm a preferred time for a short 30m call on Dec 8 to walk through the package — morning (9–11am PT) works on our side.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
mobile: (415) 555-0182
attachments: initial-evidence-checklist.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-02T09:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: privacy addendum / DPIA evidence (Oakridge County procurement)

Diego — looping in scope details. Quick notes from Security (for DPIA & artifact pull):

- SOC 2: We have a current Type II report covering 2025-07 — 2026-07. Procurement often requests a bridge letter when the report end date is outside their review window; I can prepare Redwood_SOC2_Type2_bridge.pdf that summarizes controls and any changes since the report period.
- Retention & logs: provide retention-policy excerpt (data-retention-policy.md) and three redacted audit log snippets (API-access-logs-202611.zip stub).
- SCCs: we maintain a standard SCCs execution checklist; I'll fill the county's template and attach SCCs_execution_checklist.docx.
- FedRAMP-adjacent ask: County asked whether Redwood is "FedRAMP-adjacent" — we are not FedRAMP authorized, but we can provide network segmentation, customer-managed VPC options, and KMS integration notes. I suggest clarifying language in the addendum rather than accepting a FedRAMP clause verbatim.

Owners for artifacts: Marissa (security) for SOC2 bridge & logs; Monica (privacy/contracts) for DPA redline guidance; Diego to coordinate delivery and the county meeting.

Marissa
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
attachments: artifact-list.txt

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@oakridge.gov>

Date: 2026-12-04T11:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: privacy addendum / DPIA evidence (Oakridge County procurement)

Hi Laura — attaching the consolidated package for your review (see Drive link below). Summary of what we attached:

1) Redwood_SOC2_Type2_bridge.pdf — short bridge attestation summarizing current controls and applicable scope.
2) Oakridge_DPIA_template_filled.xlsx — DPIA responses (redacted where necessary).
3) SCCs_execution_checklist.docx — completed checklist tied to our DPA/SCC processes.
4) Retention policy excerpt & sample redacted logs (available via secure link).

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1oakridge-dpia-evidence
DocuSign (preferred for county forms): we can accept DocuSign for final signature; please share the envelope or we can upload a redlined DPA and send back.

Proposed quick call: Dec 8, 10:00am PT (30m) — confirm and I'll send an invite.

Thanks,
Diego
Senior Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_bridge.pdf; Oakridge_DPIA_template_filled.xlsx; SCCs_execution_checklist.docx

From: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@oakridge.gov>

Cc: Oakridge County Legal <procurement@oakridge.gov>, Diana Shaw <diana.shaw@consult-privacy.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: privacy addendum / DPIA evidence (Oakridge County procurement)

Diego — thanks for the quick turnaround. The package looks good on first pass. A couple of follow-ups from County Legal and our external privacy advisor (Diana):

- County Legal: please confirm we can track a DPA redline set in DocuSign. They will circulate a standard county addendum and need Redwood's suggested redlines returned in DocuSign form.
- Diana (consultant): noted the SOC 2 bridge; can you confirm how long audit logs are retained by default for customer data and whether logs are accessible for audit (on request)?

We'd like the call on Dec 8 at 10:00am PT. I've scheduled a 30m meeting and sent a calendar invite to the addresses above. See procurement ticket: https://procurement.oakridge.gov/tickets/2319.

Laura
Senior Procurement Analyst
Oakridge County

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@oakridge.gov>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-08T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: privacy addendum / DPIA evidence (Oakridge County procurement)

Laura — confirmed for 12/08 10:00am PT. Quick answers ahead of the call:

- Default audit-log retention: 90 days for high-fidelity access logs, aggregated metrics retained 2 years. We can discuss longer retention or customer-managed retention during the meeting; Marissa will present options.
- Logs access: logs can be provided as redacted extracts for audit purposes under NDA; we do not give direct read access to our internal logging infrastructure but provide signed extracts and verification steps.
- DocuSign: we can receive your county envelope and propose redlines. Rishi (cc'd) will support legal review during the meeting.

Attached: artifact manifest and secure link to redacted logs for Legal review. Looking forward to the call.

Diego Fernandez
Senior Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
attachments: artifact-manifest.txt; secure-logs-link (internal)
